## TARGETED RESEARCH REPORT: `/our-mission` Page Reconstruction

### 1. **SHARED LAYOUT PATTERN**

Canonical component ordering across pages:

**`how-it-works/page.tsx`:**
- GradientPageBg (background)
- HowWorksHero
- AgencyFit
- HowWorksSteps
- ProcessSteps
- RiskRemoval
- **BetaCta** (end)

**`our-works/page.tsx`:**
- WorkPageBg (background)
- OurWorksHero
- PortfolioGrid
- OurWorksCta
- (No BetaCta, no NewsletterSignup)

**`contact/page.tsx`:**
- ContactHero
- ContactInfoCards
- ContactFormSection
- **BetaCta** (end)

**Canonical pattern (consensus):**
1. Hero section (page-specific)
2. Core content sections (page-specific)
3. **BetaCta** (shared footer CTA)
4. *Footer automatically included globally* (via layout)

Note: NewsletterSignup and CtaBanner are NOT used inline on these pages—they appear in Footer and are custom-called only when needed (like on Beta page). No consistent shared pattern for them across pages.

---

### 2. **SHARED COMPONENT IMPORTS & SIGNATURES**

**`src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`**
- Export: `function Navbar()`
- Props: None (fully self-contained)
- Features: BetaPopup modal, sticky nav on scroll, mobile nav sheet, navigation dropdowns

**`src/components/layout/footer.tsx`**
- Export: `function Footer()`
- Props: None (fully self-contained)
- Features: Newsletter form, 4-column link grid, social icons, copyright

**`src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx`**
- Export: `function BetaCta()` — standalone section (no props)
- Export: `function BetaPopupTrigger()` — button + modal (no props)
- Class module: `beta-cta.module.css`

**`src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.tsx`**
- Export: `function NewsletterSignup()` (no props)
- Accepts no props, hardcoded text

**`src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx`**
- Export: `function CtaBanner(props)`
- Props:
  ```tsx
  {
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    primaryCta?: { label: string; href: string };
    secondaryCta?: { label: string; href: string };
    bullets?: string[];
    align?: "center" | "left";
  }
  ```
- Default layout: centered; left-aligned variant with bullets supported

---

### 3. **SEO METADATA PATTERN**

**Pattern from `src/lib/seo/metadata.ts`:**

```tsx
export function createMetadata({
  title: string;
  description: string;
  path?: string;
  ogImage?: string;
  type?: "website" | "article" | "profile";
  noindex?: boolean;
  publishedTime?: string;
  modifiedTime?: string;
  authors?: string[];
})
```

**Export in page files:**
```tsx
export const metadata = createMetadata({
  title: "Page Title | Boldteq",
  description: "SEO description...",
  path: "/page-slug",
  ogImage: "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/[path].png", // optional
});
```

**Breadcrumb schema pattern:**
```tsx
import { JsonLd, breadcrumbSchema } from "@/lib/seo/jsonld";

const breadcrumbs = breadcrumbSchema([
  { name: "Page Name", path: "/page-slug" },
]);

// In JSX:
<JsonLd data={breadcrumbs} id="schema-breadcrumbs" />
```
